upstream_env_url.description: URL to upstream environment variable documentation

dependencies.description: Other containers in this repository that this container depends on at runtime

opt_dependencies.description: Other containers in this repository that this container can optionally use at runtime

compose.description: Optional docker-compose service-spec fragment merged on top of the service generated for this app. Uses compose-spec merge semantics; any field accepted under services.<name> in a docker-compose file is allowed here.

resources.description: Optional CPU/memory limits and reservations applied to the generated service via the compose deploy.resources block. Any field omitted falls back to the generator's default (currently cpus: 4, memory: 4G for limits; no reservations).

cap_add.description: Additional Linux capabilities to grant the container on top of the default cap_drop: [ALL] baseline. Use bare capability names without the CAP_ prefix (e.g. NET_BIND_SERVICE, SYS_ADMIN).

privileged.description: Run the container in privileged mode. Defaults to false; set to true only when the workload genuinely needs full host capabilities.

shm_size.description: Size of /dev/shm inside the container. Accepts a compose-spec size string (e.g. "256M", "1G") or a raw byte count. Defaults to 256M.

name.description: Name of another container in this repository (its directory under apps/). Used to look up the dependency's settings.yaml and as the docker-compose service name.

compose.description: Optional docker-compose service-spec fragment. Merged on top of the service generated from the dependency's own settings.yaml using compose-spec merge semantics. The 'image' field, if set, overrides the generated ghcr.io/trueforge-org/<name>:<version> reference.

resourceQuota.description: A docker-compose deploy.resources quota (limits or reservations).

memory.description: Memory amount in compose-spec syntax, e.g. 512M, 4G or a raw byte count.
